precedence: Lower priority number wins. Case-supplied rules default to priority 10, builtin rules use 100+. When two rules target the same (applies_to, condition) the higher-precedence transform runs and the suppressed rule is listed in result.suppressed_rules.

rules.name: row_identity_preserve
rules.condition: a row identifier column exists
rules.transform: keep value verbatim as string; never renumber rows
rules.failure_mode: renumbering breaks traceability

rules.name: row_identity_derive
rules.condition: no row identifier column, or a blank value
rules.transform: generate derived-<n> and log a degradation
rules.failure_mode: derived ids are not original identities and must be reported

rules.name: field_map_synonym
rules.condition: original column name matches a synonym or a schema field
rules.transform: map column to target field name, record mapping basis
rules.failure_mode: guessing a mapping without a synonym hit

rules.name: header_unit_extract
rules.condition: unit is embedded in the column header
rules.transform: split header into indicator text plus unit; unit becomes the row unit when the unit column is empty
rules.failure_mode: leaving 'eV' inside the indicator name

rules.name: wide_table_melt
rules.condition: no value column but several measured columns
rules.transform: melt measured columns into long rows, row_id becomes <row_id>@<column slug>
examples: one paper row with 5 measured columns -> 5 rows
rules.failure_mode: keeping wide format blocks unit handling

rules.name: missing_preserve
rules.condition: cell is blank or a missing token (n.r., n.d., -, NA, not reported)
rules.transform: value stays null, value_text keeps the original token, status=missing; never write 0
rules.failure_mode: missing coerced to zero pollutes statistics

rules.name: range_split
rules.condition: cell holds a range such as 12-15 or 1.2-1.5
rules.transform: value_low and value_high converted independently; value stays null; no midpoint
rules.failure_mode: collapsing a range to a midpoint invents a measurement

rules.name: error_term_keep
rules.condition: cell holds value +/- error
rules.transform: value and err stored separately, both converted with the same factor
rules.failure_mode: dropping the error term

rules.name: unit_convert_affine
rules.condition: source unit and canonical unit share a dimension signature
rules.transform: after = before * factor + offset; change log records factor, offset and the written formula
rules.failure_mode: converting across a dimension mismatch

rules.name: unit_unknown_hold
rules.condition: unit token is a.u./arb./unknown, unparsable, or a dimension mismatch
rules.transform: no conversion, cleaned value stays null, status=needs_review, entry in pending_review
rules.failure_mode: guessing a unit or substituting zero

rules.name: unit_missing_hold
rules.condition: value present but unit cell empty
rules.transform: keep value and null unit, status=needs_review, pending_review reason missing_unit
rules.failure_mode: assuming the canonical unit

rules.name: synonym_normalize
rules.condition: material or indicator text has a known synonym or a formula spelling variant
rules.transform: map to the normalized label, keep original text in original_value/original_name
rules.failure_mode: over-normalizing two different substances into one label

rules.name: dedup_key_exact
rules.condition: two rows share judgment key and identical normalized value+unit
rules.transform: merge into the lowest row_id, other row status=merged_duplicate with duplicate_of
examples: same source, same condition, same 3.2 eV twice -> one row
rules.failure_mode: merging across different sources or conditions

rules.name: dedup_keep_replicates
rules.condition: two rows share judgment key but different values within tolerance
rules.transform: keep both rows, later one status=replicate, action keep_separate with reason
rules.failure_mode: averaging replicates and losing n

rules.name: source_conflict_flag
rules.condition: same judgment key, values differ beyond tolerance
rules.transform: keep both original values, add source_conflict to pending_review; conversion must not be used to explain the difference away
rules.failure_mode: rescaling one value to force agreement

rules.name: value_bounds_check
rules.condition: a schema or rule supplies an allowed range for the indicator
rules.transform: out-of-range values kept but status=needs_review with reason out_of_range
examples: band gap 25 eV for an oxide
rules.failure_mode: silently deleting outliers

rules.name: precision_record
rules.condition: always
rules.transform: record source decimal places in change log precision field; converted value printed to 6 significant digits
rules.failure_mode: presenting converted digits as if measured

rules.name: status_assign
rules.condition: always
rules.transform: status in ok|needs_review|missing|replicate|merged_duplicate|conflict
rules.failure_mode: one status for everything

rules.name: encoding_recover
rules.condition: file fails strict utf-8
rules.transform: retry utf-8-sig, gb18030, latin-1; record degradation and count replacement characters
rules.failure_mode: crashing on a non-utf8 export

rules.name: empty_table_hold
rules.condition: records file exists but has zero data rows
rules.transform: status=insufficient_evidence, keep contract fields, list the gap
rules.failure_mode: reporting a successful clean of nothing

judgment_key.notes: Rows that differ in source or in any condition column never share a judgment key, so different experiments are never merged.

condition_summary.note: canonical k=v; k=v text built from condition columns

value.note: null for missing, range, error-only or needs_review rows

value_text.note: parse-normalized text of the source cell

rule_ids.note: semicolon separated rule ids applied to this row

texts.report_title: 文献数据清洗异常与边界报告
texts.report_intro: 由 literature-data-cleaner v%s 依据本次实际输入生成（非示例）。

claim.converted: %s 的 %s 由 %s %s 按 %s 归一为 %s %s
claim.pending: %s 的 %s 未能确认（%s），已列入待人工确认，未写成真值
claim.counts: 读入 %d 行抽取记录，清洗后 %d 行，可直接统计 %d 行；重复合并 %d 行，冲突 %d 组，待人工确认 %d 条
claim.passthrough: %s 的 %s 为单位一致数值 %s %s

method_notes: 算对标准 1: 每个输出值能沿 row_id -> original_value -> rule_id -> change_log.formula 回到输入行。
算对标准 2: after = before*factor + offset，verify_report.json 逐行复算一致率应为 100%。
算对标准 3: 未知/缺失单位不换算，cleaned.csv 单元格为空且 status=needs_review。
算对标准 4: 区间与误差不压成单值；不同来源/条件的行不合并。
复跑方式: 同一 --input 加 --determinism 连跑两次，8 个产物应逐字节一致。
boundary: 只做字面可判定的编码与换算；单位能算而科学上矛盾时标 source_conflict，不靠换算抹平。
未确认值只在 pending_review.csv，cleaned.csv 对应单元格为空。
无目标 schema 时使用 references/rules_library.json 的 target_schema。
无法识别单位、缺单位、文本型测量值一律不猜。
condition 列仅作为判定键与文本保留，不做条件单位换算。
